signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage with a split-level house, driveway and front lawn; partly obscured by trees.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is green and trees and shrubs are tidy, but there is no crew or equipment, so it looks homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: A silver SUV is parked at the top of the asphalt driveway, there are white lawn chairs in the front yard, and a small shed sits to the right; the asphalt driveway looks somewhat worn.
